content.title: most college basketball national championships ucla kentucky north carolina
content.text: In April 2021, Baylor became the 36th DI men's basketball program to win a national championship. In the prior NCAA tournament, Virginia added its name to that list and the year before that, Villanova joined an exclusive club as the Wildcats became just the eighth school to win at least three men's basketball national championships. There have been 15 schools that have won multiple national titles, led by UCLA with 11 titles. Here is the complete list of schools that have won the most national championships, listed in order of the number of titles, then alphabetically.
